description.en: Embeds a Strata model server monitor in Harness: model state, decode/prefill speed, GPU metrics, conversation cache and recent requests, plus a floating mini window and a composer status strip.
description.zh: 在 Harness 里嵌入 Strata 模型服务器监控：模型状态、解码/预填充速度、GPU 指标、会话缓存与最近请求，附悬浮小窗与输入框状态条。
